description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆指数的K线数据（正常点位/全收益率点位）。可按指数代码、时间范围进行筛选，支持正常点位和全收益率点位两种类型，返回日期、开盘价、收盘价、最高价、最低价、成交量、成交额、涨跌幅等数据。当用户想查看某指数的历史走势、计算指数收益率/全收益率时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain K-line (candlestick) data for A-share indices (normal points/total return points). Filters can be applied by index code and date range, supporting both normal points and total return point types, returning fields such as date, open, close, high, low, volume, amount, and price change (CSI index total return data is not available before 2016). Call this interface when users want to view historical trends of an A-share index or calculate index returns.

instruction: 中证指数全收益率2016年以前没有数据。
